name: calendar-meetings-assistant
description: This plugin is for anyone who wants help with their calendar around meetings and time away. To prepare for time off, the out-of-office skill finds meeting conflicts and suggests who to notify, based on your recent meetings. After you approve each step, it declines or cancels meetings and sends a calendar notice to the people you choose. It also drafts your email auto-reply and gives you the steps to turn it on. If you connect Slack, it can set your status too. For meetings, you can turn notes or a transcript into decisions, owned action items, and open questions. You can also summarize standup notes into blockers, progress, and plans. The out-of-office skill works through your Microsoft Outlook calendar. The meeting and standup skills work from notes that you provide.

connectors.label: Microsoft Outlook
connectors.description: The out-of-office skill reads your meetings from this calendar. After you confirm, it declines or cancels meetings and sends invites from it.
